description: Get post-offering price performance: for each recorded offering, how the stock traded after it priced or closed. Use when assessing how the market has absorbed this issuer's past financings. 🔴 THIS IS HISTORY, NOT A FORECAST — it describes what happened after prior offerings and must never be phrased as an expectation, a price target or a prediction about a named company. An empty or unavailable series means no offering performance was measured, NOT that offerings had no effect and NOT that there were no offerings. ALWAYS RETURNS 200: read `available` and `reason`, never the HTTP status. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. NULL, absent or withheld means NOT MEASURED; it never means "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and defeats a null check: decide from the availability/withheld/reason field, never from the value itself. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted, never published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_dilution_performance
title: Get Post-Offering Price Performance
